DevPagerBot: :rotating_light: PAGER - P1 hosted-api error-rate spike detected (us-west-2). Alerts: 5xx increase, 12% errors last 10m. Incident channel: #incident-1768510000.

Alex Kim: Taking over the overnight shift now (00:00-08:00). I see the P1 from the bot. Who's going to drive and who will handle comms? I can start triage but want to be explicit about roles.

Maya Chen: thanks — quick handoff: i was primary for the previous shift. context: we saw a sudden KV cache OOM on replica pool gc-3 leading to cascading 504s. cpu spikes on inference-router proxies. metrics: request_error_rate.googlesheet shows spike starting 22:12 UTC. suspected memory leak in kv-cache v2.1 rollout. runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/hosted-api-err-spike (see "Initial Triage" and "Rollback path").

Maya Chen: commands I ran:
```
# check pod logs
kubectl -n hosted-api logs svc/router-1 -c router --since=15m
# check kv-cache mem usage
kubectl -n infra top pod -l app=kv-cache
# drain suspected node
kubectl cordon node/gpu-node-17
```

Alex Kim: OK i'll be incident driver (triage + mitigations). I'll run those checks now.

Priya Rao: I'll own comms — i'll do status updates to customers and post concise messages to the status page. tagging ops-notify and customer success. @Alex Kim pls paste any user-visible impact summary (percent of requests failing, affected regions).

Samir Patel: i'll be secondary/rollback owner. if we need to revert kv-cache v2.1 i'll prepare the rollout revert and coordinate with infra. FYI i start coverage at 03:00 but can be on-call pager backup now if needed between 00:00-03:00. there's a small coverage gap between 02:00-03:00 for on-call rotation; i've updated my calendar to cover 02:30-04:00 if that helps.

Alex Kim: status for comms: us-west-2 ~12% 5xx, us-east minimal, eu unaffected. error manifests as 504 on generation endpoints (text-gen). Customers with streaming sessions might see partial responses. Estimated affected transactions: ~1.8k/min at peak.

Priya Rao: good — i'll post to status page in 10m: "Partial 5xxs affecting text-gen in us-west-2; engineering investigating; no data exposure reported." i'll ping key customers on the watchlist.

Maya Chen: runbook pointer for driver: Step 3 => enable prefix KV cache bypass:
```
curl -X POST https://infra-api.internal/kv-cache/override -d '{"mode":"bypass","target":"us-west-2"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $SVC_TOKEN'
```
that reduces pressure while we decide rollback. Also check /metrics?name=kv_cache_mem_percent.

Alex Kim: will try bypass now. I'll also stash snapshots of router logs and paste key snippets to the incident thread.

DevPagerBot: :information_source: Incident channel created: #incident-1768510000. Pager escalations: primary Alex Kim, secondary Samir Patel, ops-slo-alerts live.

Samir Patel: noted. If bypass doesn't drop error-rate within 5-10m we should escalate to rollback. I'll prepare helm rollback plan and be ready to execute on approval.

Alex Kim: assigning ownership in the tracker: Driver = Alex Kim, Comms = Priya Rao, Secondary/Rollback = Samir Patel, Handoff contact = Maya Chen. I'll update the incident ticket with those roles.

Priya Rao: :white_check_mark: confirmed. i'll send the first customer update after your next log snippet @Alex Kim.

Maya Chen: leaving a final note: check autoscaler logs for burst activity and the kernel OOM logs on nodes. Also watch for the kv-cache GC churn metric (kv_cache_gc_count). If we see repeated OOMs, we'll escalate hardware/add memory.

Alex Kim: acknowledged. starting bypass now, will post results in ~5m. thanks all for quick handoff.
